outcome: Blood glucose concentration (fasting and postprandial 2-h blood glucose)
cohort: 120 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) receiving regular obstetric examinations in a tertiary-level hospital in Bengbu City, randomized into a study group and a control group.
finding: The self-management-cluster-based pregnancy care model (SMB-CPCM) effectively improved self-management ability, psychological status, and blood glucose control, and reduced adverse delivery outcomes in pregnant women with GDM.
mod_finding: The study group implementing SMB-CPCM demonstrated an elevated spontaneous delivery rate compared to the control group.
